Holy Moley

HOW TO PLAY

Dig for crystals deep underground and reach the exit before the clock runs out.

CONTROLS

Arrow keys / WASD — walk and dig

Touch — swipe to move one cell; keep your finger down to keep walking that way

G or the 🎮 button — on-screen arrow pad (hold to keep moving)

P pause  •  V air-flow effect  •  F full screen  •  H / Esc this menu  •  E level editor

DIGGING

Moley digs through earth; tunnels stay open. Brick, coal, wood, mushrooms and bedrock can't be dug.

BOULDERS

Don't dig under rocks for long — they wobble, then fall and squash you.

Push a boulder sideways into open space. Boulders roll off other boulders.

CRYSTALS & THE EXIT

Collect every crystal. The exit stays dark and locked until the last one is gone —

then it lights up: walk in to clear the level and earn a bonus.

BOMBS & NUKES

Bombs explode when they land after a fall or get caught in a blast (3 × 3). Push against one to light its fuse — then run (3 s)!

☢ Nukes blast everything within 5 cells.

COAL

Coal burns! It is solid like brick, but explosions set it alight. Fire spreads along a seam

and burnt coal crumbles into a gap — whatever rests on it falls.

WOOD

Wood burns like coal but twice as fast, and fire jumps between wood and coal.

Termites chew through wood, leaving a tunnel — watch out for what was resting on it.

MUSHROOMS

Mushrooms grow, then spread spores — fast along tunnels, slower into wood, slowest into earth. They're solid, fireproof and only termites eat them.

When a mushroom patch runs out of room it dies: 256 cells or fewer turn into crystals (the exit locks again), bigger patches turn into boulders.

TERMITES

Termites crawl along tunnel floors and up and down shaft walls. Touching one costs a life.

Drop a boulder on a termite to blow it up like a bomb — or drop a crystal on it to squash it quietly.

WATER

Water flows through tunnels and pours into anything you dig open. Moley can swim, but fully under water an air bar drains — surface before it runs out!

Termites drown, boulders sink slowly and blasts boil water into steam.

LAVA

Glowing lava flows like water but burns anything alive — Moley, termites and mushrooms. It lights coal, wood, bombs and nukes.

Where lava meets water, both turn into steam.

TIME & LIVES

Each level has a time limit (3:00). A warning sounds at 0:30 and the last 10 s tick away.

Run out of time and it's game over. You have 3 lives; losing one restarts the level.

LEVEL EDITOR

Paint your own levels with earth, tunnels, boulders, crystals, bombs, nukes, brick, coal, wood, mushrooms, water, lava and termites,

set the size and time limit, save, export / import and play-test them.
